svg.text: Why glycine is every third residue in collagen
orange: Gly at the crowded center
open circles: X and Y (often Pro, Hyp)
face outward, where there is room
✓ tiny side chain fits where the 3 chains meet
✗ Disulfides need cysteine (sulfur). ✗ Vitamin C hydroxylates Pro and Lys, not Gly.
✗ Glycine's side chain is a single H: uncharged.
